name: codemap
description: Offline map of a Laravel backend and a Next.js frontend: which component calls which endpoint, and which code handles it. With an opt-in security lens.. Maps Laravel and Next.js code, the endpoints between them and an optional security lens, inside the editor; fully offline.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, CodeMap still maps the code (it only reads files and never runs them) but ignores the "security" section of the workspace's codemap.config.json: an untrusted config could classify middleware so that unprotected routes look protected.

codemap.backend.markdownDescription: Laravel project root, relative to the workspace folder (like `--backend`). Empty: from `codemap.config.json`, else detected.

codemap.frontend.markdownDescription: Next.js project root, relative to the workspace folder (like `--frontend`). Empty: from `codemap.config.json`, else detected.

codemap.configFile.markdownDescription: Config file to use, relative to the workspace folder (like `--config`). Empty: the nearest `codemap.config.json` in or above the projects, as the command line looks for it.

codemap.security.markdownDescription: Add the security lens (like `--security`): route protection signals for review. A review aid, not a scanner.
